title: Alaska Saltwater Charters
specs: Year-round King Salmon fishery with fish 10 to 60 pounds
Silver Salmon run mid-July through mid-September, 8 to 15 pounds
Red Salmon run early May through July
Chum Salmon run early April through June
Halibut and rockfish occasionally caught as bycatch
If you can ride in the back seat of a car, you should be fine for seasickness

includes: Fish bled and placed in slush ice immediately
Use of commercial power troller with advanced fish finding and navigational equipment
gap: Duration of the charter not stated
blurb: Guests fish for ocean run salmon using a commercial power troller equipped with advanced fish finding and navigational equipment. The charter emphasizes quality fish handling including bleeding and chilling fish immediately to preserve freshness. Filleting, packaging, freezing, and shipping services are available from local businesses at the dock.
extraNote: 50% non-refundable deposit to hold dates · Full payment required 30 days before charter · Refund only if dates can be rebooked · Full refund or reschedule if cancelled at dock due to bad weather or mechanical issue
